Put written rules around scope, use snapshots before every run, disable shared folders and clipboard integration, and have a second person verify the network boundary. A safe implementation can be a graph-based program that never opens sockets or invokes a shell; it can accept only a seed, graph, and probability settings, then emit JSON events for analysis. I can help write that simulator or a defensive detection test with harmless fixtures. I will not provide exploit code, self-propagating logic, persistence commands, destructive payloads, or procedures for testing against live systems.
